name: agent-spend-kit
description: Self-hosted budget controller, virtual-card policy engine, and receipt ledger for autonomous AI agents

scripts.build: npm run build -w @agent-spend-kit/sdk && npm run build -w @agent-spend-kit/server && npm run build -w @agent-spend-kit/dashboard
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @agent-spend-kit/sdk && npm run typecheck -w @agent-spend-kit/server && npm run typecheck -w @agent-spend-kit/dashboard && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.check.json
